footer.mission: A pan-African community where founders build, pitch, get challenged and grow.

hero.body: Africa Founders Factory is a community where entrepreneurs challenge their ideas, sharpen their pitch, strengthen their ventures and connect with people who can help them move forward.

problem.body: Most founders don't lack ambition. They lack the pressure-testing, storytelling and access that turn a promising idea into a venture people believe in.

items.title: Unclear Positioning
items.body: A founder may understand the idea deeply while the market still doesn't understand why it matters.

items.title: Weak Storytelling
items.body: A good business badly explained can look like a bad business.

items.title: Lack of Challenge
items.body: Without external feedback, assumptions easily become convictions.

items.title: Limited Access
items.body: Talent is everywhere. Access to experienced people isn't.

sentences: Every founder starts with a rough idea worth pressure-testing.
Sharpen the story until it is impossible to misunderstand.
Turn the idea into something real people can react to.
Say it out loud, in front of people who will push back.
Face direct, expert scrutiny of the venture and the story.
Take the feedback and rebuild the weak parts.
Meet the people who can open the next door.
Keep moving, one iteration at a time.

scoring.body: Every founder enters the Factory at a different stage. Africa Founders Factory will help founders understand where their venture stands, identify critical gaps and focus their energy on what needs improvement next.
scoring.disclaimer: Not an investor rating. Not a valuation. Not a fundraising promise — a structured diagnostic to help founders understand their readiness.

cards.title: PITCH READINESS
cards.gap: The problem is understandable, but the value proposition remains too broad.

cards.title: MARKET VALIDATION
cards.gap: Customer assumptions are not sufficiently validated.

mission.body1: Africa Founders Factory is a pan-African community built around one loop: build, pitch, get challenged, improve, connect, grow. There are no paid plans, no consulting packages and no fundraising promises today — only a place where founders can pressure-test their ideas against real people who understand the journey.
mission.body2: We believe the biggest constraint on African founders isn't a shortage of ideas — it's the lack of structured challenge, storytelling practice and access to experienced people that turns a promising idea into a venture people believe in.

about.headline: A pan-African community, built community-first.
about.body1: Africa Founders Factory is starting as a community: founders, aspiring founders, experts, mentors, operators, diaspora and ecosystem partners, gathering around one loop — build, pitch, get challenged, improve, connect, grow.
about.body2: There are no paid plans, consulting packages or subscriptions today. Advanced programs may come later, once the community and the Factory model are proven together.
